context: Customer/Payer crypto checkout UX across hosted checkout (/pay/*) and embedded storefront checkout (/order/*, [handle]/checkout).

design_philosophy.mantra: Trust, clarity, and zero friction. Crypto payments made as effortless as credit card checkouts.
rules: Match existing checkout paper card aesthetic: max-width ~450px single panel or 1080px dual panel, 14-16px border-radius, subtle hairline borders, soft elevation.
Primary Accent: Indigo (#4338CA light, #818CF8 dark) with gentle indigo tint backgrounds.
Numbers & Crypto: Tabular-nums monospace (IBM Plex Mono / SF Mono) for precise alignment.
Copy & Headings: Clean sans-serif (Manrope / Outfit / Inter) with clear visual hierarchy.
Never restart checkout on expiry: In-place 'Refresh quote' re-quotes the exact same coin/network while keeping buyer in context.
Explicit Policy Copy: Reassuring, exact micro-copy for overpayments, underpayments, and below-minimum payments.

asset_network_unit.concept: Present asset + network as a single unified unit with clear badge formatting.

amount_block.concept: Crypto amount and fiat equivalent rendered with equal legibility and side-by-side/stacked tabular layout.

primary_crypto.copy_button: One-tap copy button next to crypto figure

price_freshness.indicator: Live rate timestamp indicator (e.g. 'Rate updated 12s ago')

coin_network_picker.concept: Tile grid selection with automatic minimum amount validation per coin/network.

tile_states.selected: 2px solid ACCENT border, subtle ACCENT tint fill, check mark icon

disabled_below_minimum.tooltip: Order total is below this coin's minimum deposit requirement ({min_amount} {symbol}).

price_lock_timer.concept: Price-lock countdown timer with progressive visual escalation.
price_lock_timer.amber_state: Triggers under 300 seconds (5 min). Shift border and text to Amber (#B45309 light / #F59E0B dark).
price_lock_timer.red_pulsing_state: Triggers under 120 seconds (2 min). Shift to Red/Coral (#B91C1C light / #FF7A6B dark) with soft breathing pulse animation.
price_lock_timer.progress_bar: 3px hairline progress bar at top/bottom of status strip decreasing from 100% to 0%.

status_timeline_3step.concept: Replaces plain loading spinners with an explicit 3-step live status stepper connected to polling / SSE socket.

steps.label: Detected
steps.description: Payment detected on-chain / mempool. Awaiting network confirmations.

steps.label: Confirming
steps.description: Transaction broadcasting in block. Finalizing settlement.

visual_design.connector_line: 2px horizontal line between step dots (green fill on completed, gray on pending)
visual_design.completed_dot: Checkmark icon with volt green fill

expired_state_refresh_quote.concept: Invoice expiration preserves buyer context and re-quotes the SAME coin/network in place.
rules: DO NOT redirect or reset the checkout flow.
DO NOT force the buyer to re-select coin/network or return to merchant cart.
Display expired notice banner with 'Refresh quote' action button.
Clicking 'Refresh quote' calls getCurrencyRates and addPayment in place, refreshing timer to 30 mins and updating the pay-to address / amount instantly.

overpayment.policy: The ENTIRE excess is credited to the MERCHANT (not refunded to buyer).
overpayment.headline: Overpayment Received
overpayment.body_copy: You sent {excess_crypto} {symbol} (≈ {excess_fiat}) extra. The excess has been credited to the merchant account. Contact the merchant if you require an adjustment.

underpayment.policy: Prompt buyer to top up remaining amount within grace period.
underpayment.headline: Partial Payment Received
underpayment.body_copy: We received {paid_amount} {symbol}. Please send the remaining {remaining_amount} {symbol} (≈ {remaining_fiat}) to complete your order before the timer expires.
underpayment.tone: Actionable, amber callout banner with dedicated 'Pay remaining' QR/address view

below_minimum.policy: Payment below platform/network minimum is non-recoverable and credited to platform.
below_minimum.headline: Amount Below Network Minimum
below_minimum.body_copy: Transfers below {min_amount} {symbol} cannot be processed by the network and are non-recoverable. Please check network minimums before sending.

deep_link_button.action: Opens crypto URI scheme (e.g. ethereum:, bitcoin:, solana:) on mobile

memo_destination_tag_block.rendering: Displayed directly below pay-to address as a high-visibility required copy field.
memo_destination_tag_block.warning: MEMO/Tag is REQUIRED for XRP/XRPL transfers. Missing tag will delay or lose deposit.

elements: Confetti particle burst animation (canvas-confetti, ~60 particles, 1.6s duration)
Download PDF receipt button & Share receipt link button

a11y_rules: All interactive buttons must have 44px min touch target on mobile.
Color contrast ratios must exceed 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large/bold text.
Motion keyframes must respect prefers-reduced-motion media query.
Tabular-nums must be enforced on all financial figures.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Never use generic flashy gradients or rainbow overlays. Use subtle 1px hairline borders, clean typography, and precise spacing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension: Use .js or .jsx file extensions (React JS environment). Do not create .tsx files unless existing files dictate.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Use generous internal card padding (p-6 or p-8) and keep elements breathing with gap-3 / gap-4.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.state_machine: Keep status state decoupled: waiting -> detected -> confirming -> paid / expired / underpaid / overpaid.
